name: Parallax Section Block – give any section scroll-stopping depth
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Turn flat pages into scroll-stopping experiences – add a parallax section where the background moves slower than the content, right from the Gutenberg editor.

Demos

Why Parallax Section Block?

The parallax effect is a modern web design technique where the background element scrolls slower than the foreground content, creating a sense of depth as visitors move down the page. It’s a great way to highlight different sections on a lengthy page – landing pages, long-form content, sales pages, or the homepage of a business website.

Parallax Section Block lets you create a parallax section in a few clicks, with no technical knowledge required. Just add the block in the Gutenberg editor, choose your background, and adjust the settings from the sidebar. Because the effect relies on lightweight JavaScript, it stays fast – and scripts only load on pages where the block is actually used.

Free Features

  • Easy to Use: Create a parallax section directly in the Gutenberg editor – no coding needed.
  • Lightweight: Relies on JavaScript and loads scripts only when the block is used, keeping pages fast.
  • Multiple Parallax Themes: Includes Blur Effect, Vertical, Particle, Three Image, and Row Scroll parallax styles.
  • Customizable Settings: Fine-tune the block from the right-side settings sidebar.
  • Reusable: Use the block as many times as you want across posts and pages.

How to Use

  1. Install and activate the Parallax Section plugin.
  2. Add the Parallax Section block from the block category called “Widgets” in the Gutenberg editor.
  3. Change the block settings from the right-side settings sidebar.
  4. Publish – enjoy your parallax section!

Use Cases

  • Landing Pages: Highlight key sections with depth and motion.
  • Sales Pages: Keep visitors scrolling with visually distinct sections.
  • Long-Form Content: Break up lengthy pages into engaging segments.
  • Business Homepages: Add a modern, polished feel to your most important page.

sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard (recommended):

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “Parallax Section”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Add the Parallax Section block to any post or page in the Gutenberg editor.

Manual installation:

  1. Download the Parallax Section plugin (.zip file).
  2. In your admin area, go to Plugins → Add New, click Upload Plugin, choose the parallax-section.zip file, and click Install Now.
  3. Or upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory and activate it through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
Is Parallax Section free?

Yes, Parallax Section is a free Gutenberg block plugin.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, it works with any standard WordPress theme.

Will the parallax effect slow down my site?

No. The effect is lightweight JavaScript, and the plugin only loads its scripts on pages where the block is actually used.

Which parallax styles are included?

The plugin includes five parallax themes: Blur Effect Parallax, Vertical Parallax, Particle Parallax, Three Image Parallax, and Row Scroll Parallax.

Can I change the block settings?

Yes, you can change the block settings from the Gutenberg block editor’s right sidebar.

How many times can I reuse the block?

You can use the block an unlimited number of times across your site.

Where can I get support?

You can post your questions on the support forum here.

Where do I report security bugs found in this plugin?

Please report security bugs found in the source code of the Parallax Section plugin through the Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program. The Patchstack team will assist you with verification, CVE assignment, and notify the developers of this plugin.
